items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: reading the old FOX, literally reading the old advertisement’s off, which didn’t make FOX happy at all…

ctx.x: [laughs] And this was something totally new to them. So, I dug up some of those records by going down to Little Tokyo and I had seen some – there were a lot of very gory hospital scenes in that movie, you know in the – when they were operating under battlefield conditions and the lights were going out and I said, “Bob, you better have something to take all the… you know I’d like to have some music to go against this.” And I said, “I’ve got something in mind,” and I brought him this and he says, “It’s very…
